tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Principal Engineer - SAP Integration
cover_en.hook: Bringing over 5 years of specialized expertise as an SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer for global enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply for the Principal Engineer - SAP Integration role. My background in building scalable backend services, complex data pipelines, and robust integrations aligns directly with your technical goals.

bullets.label: SAP Integration & APIs
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub, while developing and exposing OCC REST Web Services for seamless multi-system communication.

bullets.label: Enterprise Architecture
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved complex integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and Profisee platforms, collaborating directly with international technical teams to ensure high availability.

bullets.label: Backend & Cloud Delivery
bullets.text: Engineered advanced backend functionality using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot, executing CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2).

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Bridged business requirements and technical implementation by analyzing integration problems, designing robust data flows, and guiding technical delivery across agile teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my integration expertise can benefit your team.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of deep SAP Commerce Cloud and integration experience to your IT Services team, applying my proven track record in building complex data pipelines and enterprise REST APIs for global platforms like Rockwell Automation and Shell.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and enterprise integration expertise to deliver robust backend solutions and seamless data pipelines.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of enterprise experience building integrations, OCC REST APIs, and data pipelines for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I noticed your SAP Integration focus and would love to connect to discuss how I can contribute.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Principal Engineer - SAP Integration – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Principal Engineer - SAP Integration position. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) platforms, OCC REST APIs, and complex data integrations for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong backend and techno-functional capabilities.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
